text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: elevated 5xx and timeouts for inference runtime in us-west-2. Multiple segfaults observed in model-runner processes. Root: model=volta-13b, route=prod-inference, error=SIGSEGV/oom during KV cache allocation. Paging sam (on-call).

sam: on it. pulling logs now — can someone confirm any deploys in the last 30m?

dana: not from product side. no recent canaries. infra-bot shows node reboots 10:06 and 10:09 UTC in us-west-2-gpu-pool-3.

sam: copying relevant log snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T10:05:42Z] model-runner[pid=1247] ERROR runtime: segfault at 0x0 in kv_cache_write+0x4b
[2026-03-15T10:05:42Z] kernel: oom-killer invoked for process model-runner pid=1247, total_alloc=12.8GB
[2026-03-15T10:05:42Z] gateway: upstream returned 502 for request id=req_8a2b
```

tariq: seeing the same in our tracing — 5xx spike started at 10:04:30 UTC. error rate across prod-inference route: baseline 0.2% -> 6.8%.

lee: initial customer impact summary from cs-bot: approx 18 customer accounts saw increased latencies and errors, top impacted are: ad-critical-ops, content-gen-pro, searchplus.

sam: immediate mitigation plan: 1) drain traffic from us-west-2 to other regions where possible, 2) switch prod-inference route to fallback model variant (volta-13b-quant-small) that uses smaller KV cache, 3) restart affected nodes and cordon faulty instances.

maya: I can take region failover. initiating route-weight override now.

oncall-bot: Route update: prod-inference weight(us-west-2)=0 -> 0.15 over 5m, weight(us-east-1)=0.7, weight(eu-west-1)=0.15. Change baked at 10:12:05 UTC.

sam: doing canary for fallback model: set model_fallback=volta-13b-quant-small for new requests in prod-inference. reducing batch_size=1 for high-latency clients.

infra-bot: command executed: 
```
redwoodctl route update prod-inference --weights us-west-2=0.15,us-east-1=0.7,eu-west-1=0.15
redwoodctl model set-default prod-inference --model volta-13b-quant-small --reason "emergency fallback - runtime segfaults"
```

sam: monitoring telemetry. error rate falling but still some 502s from nodes that are in crash-loop.

dana: I'm kicking off a rolling restart of the GPU pool and cordoning nodes with repeated SIGSEGV. running:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep model-runner | awk '{print $1}' | xargs -I{} kubectl cordon {}
kubectl rollout restart daemonset/model-runner -n inference
```

lee: got confirmation from logs that a kernel OOM path is involved — memory spike when populating KV cache for long prompts. sample trace attached:
```
#0  0x7f6d1a2b in kv_cache_write
#1  0x7f6d3f12 in transformer_forward
#2  0x7f6d4c90 in run_inference
#3  0x400f12 in worker_main
```

tariq: possible hypotheses: 1) regression in the KV cache allocator (recent C++ tweak to prefetch), 2) a rare input sequence causing unbounded cache growth, 3) regression in specific compiled kernels for Ampere/MI200 variant.

sam: for live mitigation, prioritize 1) route fallback (done), 2) reduce max_cache_size per-worker to 2GB (if hotpatch possible), 3) disable prefetch optimization on worker builds until we can reproduce locally.

maya: I can push config change to reduce max_cache_size via feature toggle. applying now.

infra-bot: feature toggle update: inference.max_kv_cache_mb=2048 applied to pool us-west-2 at 10:20:41 UTC.

sam: after route + fallback + cache limit, error rate down to 0.9% and latency returning to normal for most customers. full mitigation target: <0.5%.

dana: investigating core dumps from the segfaulted processes. pulling one for analysis and uploading to shared incident bucket.

lee: crashdump notes: segfault in allocator at address 0x0 when writing to cache index - looks like null deref in prefetch path. packing core + symbols for repro.

tariq: can we reproduce on staging with long prompt workload? if yes, we will run with address sanitizer build. else, escalate to runtime/llm infra team for deeper kernel/regression rollback.

sam: assigning tasks: dana to bucket cores + initial triage, lee to reproduce in staging and run ASAN if possible, tariq to coordinate build rollback if reproduces. maya to manage customer comms/handoff. I'll stay for handoff.

maya: on customer comms — sending proactive note to customers with highest error counts, linking status page. cs-bot will follow up with account-specific notes.

cs-bot: Draft to ad-critical-ops: "We're investigating increased 5xx and timeouts affecting inference in us-west-2. We've routed traffic to alternate regions and applied a fallback model; you may see reduced latency and consistency while we fully mitigate. Will follow up with ETA and root cause." (sent at 10:28 UTC)

sam: good. we'll prepare a short on-call handoff at 10:40 for the next shift. current status: mitigation applied, error rate ~0.6%, remaining affected nodes cordoned, cores uploaded to s3://incidents/3467891234/cores/

dana: upload complete. cores: 5, metadata with kernel version, model build hash, and attached inputs where possible.

lee: repro attempt in staging succeeded with long prompt (27k tokens) hitting same allocator path; confirms input-induced cache growth + prefetch bug. running ASAN build now.

tariq: ASAN ran — found null deref in prefetch codepath. Patch proposed to guard pointer and fallback to non-prefetch path. CI green on tests that exercise cache allocator. proposing hotpatch to disable prefetch in prod while we validate patch.

sam: approve hotpatch to disable prefetch for prod model-runner in us-west-2. Please coordinate rollout with maya and infra.

infra-bot: hotpatch command executed:
```
redwoodctl hotpatch apply model-runner --env prod --set runtime.prefetch=false --scope us-west-2
```

sam: after hotpatch, error rate stabilized at 0.2%. no new segfaults observed in the past 12m.

maya: preparing handoff note for next on-call. summary below.

maya: HANDOFF SUMMARY (to-night-oncall):
- Incident: Elevated 5xx/timeouts from runtime due to segfault/OOM during KV cache writes for model volta-13b in us-west-2.
- Timeline: Pager at 10:04 UTC -> mitigation applied (route fallback, cache cap, cordon nodes) by 10:28 UTC -> hotpatch disable prefetch at 10:36 UTC -> stabilized by 10:45 UTC.
- Current status: mitigated, error rate ~0.2%, fallback model in use for new requests. Some pods restarted; nodes cordoned awaiting replacement.
- Impact: peak error rate ~6.8%, ~18 customer accounts affected; no data leakage suspected. CS notified.
- Next steps: runtime team to ship prefetch bugfix and validate with heavy prompt regression tests; replace/uncordon faulty instances after validated kernel and model-runner build; postmortem to be authored (owners: sam, tariq, lee).
- Artifacts: cores + logs -> s3://incidents/3467891234/, route change audit -> console link: https://console.redwood.ai/routes/prod-inference/audit/3467891234

tariq: I'll own the fix PR and coordinate canary once merged. ETA for PR today EOD.

sam: thanks everyone. handing off to night oncall maya@night. I'll join postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged resolved-by-mitigation at 10:46:29 UTC (status: mitigated). Please file postmortem within 72h.

maya: acknowledged and will run follow-up incident review. tagging runtime, infra, and cs for action items. :white_check_mark:

cs-bot: Follow-up notes queued for affected accounts. Will run root-cause slide for EOW customer brief.

sam: final note — thanks for fast triage. we should add a synthetic test with long prompts for KV cache regression suite and add guardrails to reject >20k token prefix by default until cache policies improved.

maya: noted, adding to backlog and will prioritize in next sprint.

lee: closing thread for live triage. will ping when postmortem draft is ready.
